+    for a, b in zip(p[:-1], p[1:]):
+        n = max(1, int(math.ceil(float(np.linalg.norm(b - a)) / step_px)))
+        out.extend(a + (b - a) * (i / n) for i in range(1, n + 1))
+    return np.asarray(out)
+
+
+def trajectory_to(robot: Robot, pose_now, xyz, z_hover=HOVER_Z):
+    """Move to a hover point slowly, then let the joints settle there."""
+    xyz = np.asarray(xyz, dtype=float).copy()
+    xyz[2] = z_hover
+    start = np.asarray(pose_now[:3], dtype=float)
+    dist = float(np.linalg.norm(xyz - start))
+    n = max(1, int(math.ceil(dist / 0.035)))
+    rows = [np.r_[start + (xyz - start) * i / n, Q_DOWN] for i in range(1, n + 1)]
+    rows.extend([np.r_[xyz, Q_DOWN]] * 3)
+    return robot.submit("ee_pose", np.asarray(rows), dt=0.2, video="none",
+                        note="lifted reposition above scored sheet")
+
+
+def execute_stroke(robot: Robot, index: int, pose_now, save_root: pathlib.Path):
+    line_px, z = STROKES[index]
+    points = resample(line_px, step_px=5.0)
+    world = px_to_world(points, z)
+    start_world = px_to_world(np.asarray(line_px[0]), HOVER_Z)
+
+    approach = trajectory_to(robot, pose_now, start_world)
+    reached = np.asarray(approach.group("tcp_pose")[-1], dtype=float)
+    # Press at the first centerline point. The contact is one continuous stroke.
+    p0 = np.r_[world[0], Q_DOWN]
+    lower = robot.submit("ee_pose", np.asarray([p0, p0, p0]), dt=0.15, video="none",
+                         note=f"stroke {index+1}: settle at writing pressure")
+    # Slow, dense targets keep the brush close to the intended centerline.
+    rows = np.asarray([np.r_[p, Q_DOWN] for p in world[1:]], dtype=float)
+    draw = robot.submit("ee_pose", rows, dt=0.05, video="none",
+                        note=f"stroke {index+1}/16 of 靜")
+    end = np.asarray(draw.group("tcp_pose")[-1], dtype=float)
+    lifted = np.r_[world[-1, :2], HOVER_Z, Q_DOWN]
+    lift = robot.submit("ee_pose", np.asarray([lifted, lifted, lifted]), dt=0.15,
+                        video="none", note=f"lift after stroke {index+1}")
+    out = save_root / f"stroke_{index+1:02d}"
+    out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    payload = {
+        "index": index + 1,
+        "target_pixels": line_px,
+        "draw_z": z,
+        "approach_pose": reached.tolist(),
+        "stroke_end_pose": end.tolist(),
+        "actual_pose_after_lift": lift.group("tcp_pose")[-1].tolist(),
+        "calls": [approach.meta, lower.meta, draw.meta, lift.meta],
+    }
+    (out / "record.json").write_text(json.dumps(payload, indent=2))
+    return np.asarray(lift.group("tcp_pose")[-1], dtype=float)
+
+
+def main():
+    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    ap.add_argument("--from-index", type=int, default=0, help="zero-based first stroke")
+    ap.add_argument("--to-index", type=int, default=16, help="exclusive end index")
+    ap.add_argument("--save-root", default="/app/output/episode")
+    args = ap.parse_args()
+    robot = Robot()
+    status = robot.status()
+    print("status", status)
+    if status.get("done"):
+        raise RuntimeError("episode has ended")
+    pose = np.asarray(robot.get_obs(cameras=["canvas_cam"]).meta["proprio"]["now"][7:14], dtype=float)
+    for idx in range(args.from_index, min(args.to_index, len(STROKES))):
+        pose = execute_stroke(robot, idx, pose, pathlib.Path(args.save_root))
+        print("completed", idx + 1, "pose", pose.tolist(), "status", robot.status())
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
*** End Patch";
const r = await tools.apply_patch(patch);
text(r);

The trajectory script is [gen.py](/app/output/gen.py), and the final camera image is [main_final.png](/app/output/main_final.png).

A local estimate from the camera image suggests the attempt falls short of the success thresholds: IoU about 0.58, boundary F about 0.70, and stray ink about 0.15 after alignment. These are estimates; the service provides no official score.
